description: Design and size a cable (power, control, LAN, coaxial, fibre) from a sentence (Turkish or English, e.g. "3-core collective screen 12/20 kV 3x95/25 Al, longitudinally watertight") or a spec: every layer's thickness with its source (IEC 60502, HD 603 / 620, BS, EN 50525, NEC / UL and more; IEC 60228), the overall diameter, the designation and the decoder's reading of it, and the estimated weight, bending radius, pulling force, IEC 60757 colour codes and MV field stress with their sources; a bare designation works as the sentence; optional XML, DXF, SVG, CSV, GLB, STEP (3D CAD) and a PDF datasheet. Deterministic, no LLM; a nominal calculation, not a datasheet.

cpc.description: For cpc: {kind armour | core | separate (default the armour where the design has one), basis iec | bs, column tp70 | tp90 | ts90, section_mm2, metal Cu | Al (a separate conductor)}.

design.description: Instead of a sentence: the design field of an earlier answer, changed.

fault.description: For cpc: {ka (the fault current), seconds (default fault_s)}: the adiabatic check of the armour or protective conductor (IEC 60364-5-54:2011 Annex A, BS 7671 Tables 54.2 to 54.4) up to 1 kV.

formats.description: Files to include: xml, dxf, svg, csv, glb (base64), step (STEP AP214 text), pdf (datasheet, base64).

installation.description: For ratings.current: how the cable is installed; the designer's defaults for what is not given (buried 0.8 m, 20 °C ground, 1.5 K·m/W, trefoil, alone). At 0.6/1 kV group, arrangement, clearance, trays and h3_pct give the IEC 60364-5-52 B.52.17 to B.52.21 (BS 7671 4C1 to 4C3) grouping and the E.52.1 harmonic factors. The answer lists the defaults used and the fields the cable's table does not read.

arrangement.description: 0.6/1 kV in air: how the group lies (bunched, on a wall or ceiling, on perforated, vertical or unperforated trays, on ladders, spaced); default bunched.

clearance.description: 0.6/1 kV: touching (default), oneDiameter (multicore cables on an IEC tray), or the clearance in the ground between cables or ducts, m (0.125 to 1.0).

h3_pct.description: 0.6/1 kV 4- and 5-core cables: the third-harmonic share of the phase current, % (IEC 60364-5-52 Table E.52.1).

lang.description: Any of the site's 15 languages for the answer's words (the sentence itself is read in English or Turkish).

load.description: For voltage_drop and sizing: {length_m (required), amps or kw (default the design's own rating), phases 1 | 3, volts, pf (0.85), temp_c (the insulation's normal temperature), hz, limit_pct (a Table G.52.1 row 3, 5, 6, 8 raised beyond 100 m, or an own limit; default 5), conduit pvc | al | steel (NEC wires, Chapter 9 Table 9)}. IEC 60364-5-52 Annex G, BS 7671 Table 4E4B or NEC Chapter 9 Table 9, and the smallest size by current, by drop and by both.

nec.description: North American wires: {ocpd_a (the overcurrent device; default from the ampacity), phase_min (250.122(B): the size before upsizing), install raceway | air, ambient_c, carrying, termination_c 60 | 75 | 90}: nec.ampacity (NEC 310.16) and nec.egc (Table 250.122).

sentence.description: The cable in words, Turkish or English: voltage, cores, section, conductor metal, screen, sheath, watertightness, armour. What is not said takes a default, and the answer lists which.

spec.description: Instead of a sentence: {voltage: "12/20", cores: 3, section: 95, metal, screen, screenType, screenSection, insulation, sheath, watertight, armour}; add standard (an id from design_presets: HD620-10C, BS6724, UL-NMB, EN50525-2-21 ...) for that family's own build at the nearest voltage, size and count it lists.

test_variant.description: For after_installation: a national variant of the tests after installation (HD620-10A, HD620-10C, HD620-10J, HD620-10M, HD620-10R, BS6622, BS7846, BS5467, HD603-3F, HD603-G); default the one the design's standard implies.
